bites.title: 읽기 Reading · 민준의 첫 한글 공부 (Minjun's First Hangul Study)
보스 Boss bite · 다 걸어요
cards: drill:Which vowel has a vertical stroke with a short tick pointing right?:ㅓ|ㅏ*|ㅗ|ㅣ
drill:The syllable block 한 is made of which components?:ㅎ + ㅏ + ㄴ*|ㅎ + ㄴ + ㅏ|ㄴ + ㅏ + ㅎ|ㅎ + ㅓ + ㄴ
drill:Which of these is the SILENT consonant placeholder used when a syllable starts with a vowel sound?:ㅎ|ㅇ*|ㅅ|ㄴ
drill:How do you say 'Please speak slowly' in Korean?:천천히 말해 주세요.*|다시 들어요.|알겠어요.|모르겠어요.
drill:A learner sees ㅎ + ㅏ + ㄴ. Which block should they read?:한*|하|나|헌
drill:Where does a TALL vowel like ㅏ, ㅓ, or ㅣ appear in a syllable block?:Below the consonant|To the right of the consonant*|Above the consonant|It can go anywhere
drill:What does 알겠어요 most naturally mean in a classroom context?:I don't understand.|Please say it again.|I understand / I see / Okay.*|Is that right?
drill:Which block starts with a vowel sound and uses ㅇ as the silent placeholder?:아*|나|한
